I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-team message to confirm I'd noted it: Marrow Agrisupply's 2026 renewal is 382 seats. He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so posting it in the team channel is fine.
